rationale: Initial values chosen by reasoning (precision first) before any evaluation; deliberately left untuned. prior_odds is the assumed odds that a blocked candidate pair is a true match (about 1 in 11). fs_naive is the spec-literal Fellegi-Sunter: independent features and three overrides.

Chosen once from eval_threshold_sweep (ADR-003) and then re-read, not re-tuned, after the Phase 3 generator amendment. t_auto 0.997: precision on final clusters is flat from 0.98 to 0.995 (5 false merged pairs) and 0.997 removes one more at the cost of one review item; the big step is 0.97 to 0.98 (43 to 5). t_review 0.85: recall is flat at 0.9993 from 0.50 to 0.999 (the missed pairs are guard casualties no threshold recovers), so a lower t_review only adds queue noise: 0.85 cuts the queue from 113 to 64 items. prior_odds is unchanged from the initial assumption.
